# Reviso - AI-Powered Flashcard Learning App
> Turn notes, PDFs, and images into smart flashcards with spaced repetition.

## About
Reviso is an AI-powered flashcard study app that generates flashcards from notes, PDFs, and images. Uses the FSRS spaced repetition algorithm for optimal memory retention with AI-powered answer scoring.

## Key Features
- AI Flashcard Generation from notes, PDFs, and images
- Spaced Repetition System (Anki-compatible FSRS algorithm)
- AI Answer Auto-Scoring
- Study Progress Analytics with heatmaps and charts
- Adaptive Review Sessions
- Daily Goals and Reminders
- Cross-platform (iOS, Android, Web)

## Use Cases
- Medical students memorizing anatomy and pharmacology
- Language learners building vocabulary
- Exam preparation (MCAT, GRE, Bar, SAT)
- Professional certifications and continuing education
